why: Dated, externally validated marker of the ANRPTS digital layer over the Registre national des populations, carried by AMI from a Ministry of Interior communique.

A distinct event: the Interior Minister told parliament that enrolment is now a permanent year-round service under a regime in force from early 2025, and gave 5.1 million enrolled against 3.4 million in 2019.

The government describing the national addressing system as still to be built: national standard, postcodes, georeferenced identifier, GIS and a base nationale des adresses, with 218 postcode zones proposed. No law creating an address register exists.

The operative law: article 29 (nouveau) constitutes the Registre du Commerce et des Suretes Mobilieres out of local registers, beneficial-ownership registers, a Registre Central and a movable securities register.

In-window primary instrument restructuring the registration pathway: the guichet unique takes creation, immatriculation, modification and radiation, seats the Tribunal de Commerce and DGI in it, and ties the RC declaration to the NIF.

No autonomous decree creates the Registre Social; this is the strongest dated primary instrument giving it legal standing, by making enrolment in the registry the eligibility basis for Tekavoul transfers.
In-window legal instrument creating the BDS-MAC and making the Registre Social a named feeding source and analytical layer for disaster-affected households.
The register has no single founding act, so its size is the baseline: the Conseil Constitutionnel proclaims 1,939,343 registered voters after verifying every moughataa and out-of-country tally sheet.
The only in-window event bearing on the register: the CENI signs an EU and ECES memorandum under its 2025-2027 strategic plan, which names integrating modern technologies into electoral work.

DGI doctrine on article L.4 of the Livre des Procedures Fiscales: the declaration d existence within twenty days, verification of location, and assignment of the NIF. The clearest public account of how the taxpayer register is constituted.

Met end-September 2025 structural benchmark: a memorandum of understanding signed between DGI, Douanes and the Nouadhibou free zone authority, the precondition for bringing free-zone NIFs into the taxpayer file.

No text creates the SNIS; this arrete is what makes it operate, assigning SNIS collection, synthesis and analysis to the regional SPISSE and routine collection and database entry to the circonscription SSEISM.

Dated ministerial position in the Assemblee nationale: health information and digital management systems are in the model reference hospitals and about to be generalised, plus a ministry digital centre for emergencies and teleconsultation.

A distinct event: the ministry and a World Bank mission agree to begin implementing an integrated platform across hospitals, centres and health posts with centralised health data, and to form a joint technical committee.

The programme-management layer working as a system: SMS notification to registry households, self-service eligibility check, collection code and identity verification, for 2,057,006 registered citizens.

The one justice information system official sources show in service: the digitised casier judiciaire launched 28 March 2025 with remote issue through Houwiyeti and Khidmati, and an explicit statement that case management is still to come.
Signed four-year second phase with UNDP whose objects include numerisation des procedures judiciaires; the delivery vehicle for the case-management layer that does not yet exist.
The tax administration own account of JIBAYA and the STT layer, and of their weaknesses at the 2022 TADAT assessment; the most authoritative current statement of where the tax MIS stands.
The largest measured move in the window: taxes filed and paid online by large enterprises rose from 13.4 per cent in January 2025 to 39 per cent in January 2026.
The customs administration own user guide, the most direct public proof that SYDONIA World is in production and reachable by declarants over the internet from www.douanes.mr.

The most recent official account of the land systems that exist: LEEGOU to all 54 moughataas by 2027, AQAAR as a unified national land database with a unique parcel identifier, EL MOUHAFID for publicity and registration.

The design of the national land data layer stated by its owner: Aakar as a central warehouse linking register, documentation and registration over six to eight months, plus the Basira satellite application.

A distinct, launched field operation: the Nouakchott built-parcel census by the military cartography directorate with UNDP and World Bank support, 12 to 14 months, tablets, and a unique number per parcel.
